exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of up:
  -accept-license
    	accept the license of a model the catalog marks gated
  -canary string
    	override the canary policy: bitwise, tolerance, warn or off
  -concurrency int
    	blobs transferred at once (0: 64)
  -criu string
    	host CRIU binary to use instead of the image's
  -cuda-backend string
    	how CUDA state moves: driver (libcuda's checkpoint API), cli (cuda-checkpoint), or auto (driver when usable) (default "auto")
  -cuda-checkpoint string
    	host cuda-checkpoint to use instead of the image's
  -cuda-execution string
    	CUDA restore: auto (everything concurrent when no collective links the processes), serial, parallel (only the workers concurrent) or parallel-all (default "auto")
  -dmtcp-dir string
    	directory of DMTCP's programs, for the dmtcp backend (default "/opt/warmctl/dmtcp/bin")
  -dmtcp-plugin string
    	warmctl's fdkeep DMTCP plugin, for the dmtcp backend (default "/opt/warmctl/dmtcp/lib/libdmtcp_fdkeep.so")
  -docker string
    	Docker socket (default "/var/run/docker.sock")
  -gpus string
    	GPU indices (default: the first free GPUs of the snapshot's model)
  -id string
    	instance id (default: the snapshot's or the repository's name)
  -listen string
    	gateway address (default "127.0.0.1:8000")
  -mode string
    	where to restore: auto (in place in the warmctl runtime image, else through Docker), host or in-place (docs/kubernetes.md); in place the gateway defaults to :8080 (default "auto")
  -model-dir string
    	model directory, when the snapshot needs it
  -no-verify
    	canary only warns
  -plain-http
    	talk to the registry over plain HTTP
  -progress string
    	progress format: plain or jsonl (default "plain")
  -run-dir string
    	in place: the agent's config, sockets and CRIU work (default "/run/warmctl")
  -scratch string
    	accepted for compatibility
  -state-dir string
    	state directory (default "/var/lib/warmctl")
  -sync-weights
    	reload the weights with synchronous copies, not pipelined ones
  -test-cpu
    	end-to-end test on a CPU host: no GPU devices, no io_uring check
  -threads int
    	pool copy threads per rank (default 4)
  -tls-cert string
    	serve HTTPS with this PEM certificate, read again when it changes
  -tls-key string
    	the PEM private key of --tls-cert
  -verify-weights
    	check each weights part's SHA-256 while reloading
  -wait
    	accepted for compatibility
  -wait-timeout duration
    	accepted for compatibility
error: flag: help requested
